observations: Large professional hair dryer hood with a cream-colored top and dark grey lower section.
The brand 'EQUATOR' and model 'EQUATOR 2' are clearly printed on the front of the hood in photo 0 and photo 2.
The unit is mounted on a black pedestal stand.
A control dial and a power switch are visible on the top front of the hood.
A white handheld hair dryer is visible on a stand to the right, but it is not the main unit for sale.
The interior of the hood appears to be a dark, possibly black, plastic liner.
The power cord is visible and appears to be in good condition.

claims.evidence: The exterior looks clean, but the interior lining and the motor area are not visible.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A video showing the unit in operation.

risks.risk: The internal plastic liner may be cracked or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the inside of the hood with the lid open.

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or the plug may be faulty.

Photo of the inside of the hood with the lid open.

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an Equator 2 hair dryer hood. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
